name: ticket-board
description: A sidebar of the open tickets /to-tickets published: ready, needs you, claimed and blocked, with buttons to open a ticket or start implementing it in this tab or a new one.

launcher.title: Where new sessions open
launcher.description: iterm opens a new iTerm tab, terminal a new Terminal.app window (both macOS only, other systems copy), herdr a new herdr pane beside the focused one (any system), copy puts the command on the clipboard. Inside herdr, iterm opens a herdr pane too. The new session starts in the folder this session works in.

refreshSeconds.title: GitHub refresh (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often to re-read the tickets from GitHub while the sidebar is open, at least 30. All sessions on a repository share one read. Local ticket files are checked every few seconds.

implementCommand.title: Command a ticket is started with
implementCommand.description: The slash command, without the slash, run on the ticket's reference: in a new tab, or filled into this tab's prompt box.
